sources.articleTitle: Saurav Das stopped at airport over Mumbai Police lookout notice, Centre tells HC
'Look Out Circular Issued Against CJP's Saurav Das': Centre To Delhi High Court
Government tells Delhi High Court discrepancies in Saurav Das's documents may impact his citizenship
Mumbai Police issued Look Out Circular against CJP's Saurav Das: Centre tells Delhi HC

headline: Centre Confirms Look Out Circular Issued Against Saurav Das
seoTitle: Saurav Das Look Out Circular Explained
metaDescription: The Indian government informed the Delhi High Court that a Look Out Circular was issued against Saurav Das following document discrepancies found.
aiSummaryBullets: The Indian government confirmed to the Delhi High Court that a Look Out Circular has been issued against Saurav Das.
Authorities stated that document discrepancies, specifically concerning a passport, may impact his citizenship status.
Legal counsel for the CJP leader argued that he was not informed of the circular's existence, purpose, or reason for its issuance.
aiContextParagraph: The Delhi High Court is currently reviewing a matter involving Saurav Das, a leader affiliated with the Citizens for Justice and Peace. During court proceedings, the central government stated that a Look Out Circular was initiated against him by the Mumbai Police on November 23. This measure resulted in the individual being stopped at an airport. Government representatives informed the court that the legal action stems from identified discrepancies regarding his travel documentation, which they suggest may have implications for his Indian citizenship status. In response to these developments, legal representatives for the affected individual maintained that their client had not received prior notification regarding the issuance of the circular, nor were they provided with specific information regarding the underlying reasons or the intended scope of the restriction. The matter remains under ongoing judicial review to determine the validity of the government's claims and the status of the circular.
whyItIsViral: This story is trending due to high public search interest for Saurav Das and consistent coverage across four major Indian media outlets.
